title: Chapter 794

196. The Big Serpent, Ameris (3)
In this world, there are beings who are born with inexplicably powerful abilities.

The Runecandels, famous for their 'Blessed Bodies', and the pure-blooded Zephyrs with outstanding magical affinity are the most representative. For a long time in human history, these two families have dominated the world based on their bloodline characteristics.
Then there are those who come into this world, overshadowing the average potential of such families.
For example, humans who are clearly different from others the moment they are born.
Most of these individuals hail from insignificant bloodlines, and one day, without special education, they suddenly stand out.
Vanessa Olson, who awakened trying to save her younger sibling taken by a lord.
Smarion Prochi, born to ordinary farmers, suddenly became a murderer.
Hedo, who lived the life of a monster due to his supernatural strength.
According to Ameris, the source of such mysterious power these people possess was the obsession of the Sun God.

["The Sun God, Kinselo's obsession is a will to deny his own death and extinction. Thus, the beings touched by this obsession unconsciously destroy the earth and seek the altar to awaken the body of the sun."]

Hedo responded nonchalantly, nodding his head as if he found it interesting. Even if Ameris' words were true, he had already determined his life's direction and purpose, so there was no reason for him to be swayed.
"If I can just reach the altar, I can resurrect the Sun God?"

["Just reaching it isn't enough, but the resurrection of the Sun God is possible. And if he returns, it means that the entire world will vanish. The order of this world that you and I are enjoying will be destroyed, all coincidence and inevitability will disappear."]
"Shinu said the outcome depends on how the Sun God is resurrected."

["Regardless of the outcome, the moment the Sun God is resurrected, the world as you know it will inevitably disappear. Mortals will be bound by fate again, and immortals will all converge into part of the Sun God. The world will become whole again... but is that really the right form? A world full of dry satisfaction with only conformity."]
Jin and Hedo could not imagine such a world, as they had never experienced it directly.

Nor were they curious. The world they had to protect was the very ground they were standing on. They had nothing they wanted to gain at the expense of all the memories of this world they fought for following their dreams: the land they grew up on, the people they loved.
Only those without attachment to this world could wish for the resurrection of the Sun God.
["Fortunately, from what I heard from you, the Sun God's followers on the surface are not as active as they once were. Back then, there were too many of them. I had to deal with them every day."]
"Were there no other allies besides you and the benevolent heads?"

["There were, but I don't remember them well. Solderet was an adapter to the new order, so he probably cooperated with me. Clam was also an adapter, but he... was destined to destroy the surface with the power he controlled, the magic."]
-"I was once a god who controlled all the magic in the world. But when I was about to destroy the world, unable to withstand my own power, I sealed myself in this mirror with Solderet's help."
-"What this seal is blocking is the source of infinite magic, which is me. And the endlessly expanding magic can wipe out this world at any time..."
Suddenly, the words Clam had said in the past at the Colon Ruins came to mind.
"Clam was sealed by Solderet, but could he have also been influenced by the Sun God’s obsession…?”

["Indeed. Given that the power he possessed could obliterate the surface world and still be left over, he became a prey for these obsessions. He too is an unfortunate immortal, bound by a fate he does not desire."]
A fate undesired.
The 'weight of immortality' that Ameris spoke of, meant being unable to escape this fate. Ameris had to guard the boundaries of the world until her end.
Jin and Hedo quietly reflected on her role for a moment. Her lonely battle was still ongoing.
Ameris, as if reading their minds, gave a small smile.
["Haha, the more I see, the cuter you two seem. You seem to think that the fate given to me is too much."]
"That's true."
["It's a task that someone must carry out. Also, from time to time, one can receive gifts from fate. Meeting mortals like you, for example, has been such an event for me."]
Ameris had now gained comrades she could 'remember'. After all, strong humans like Jin and Hedo declared that they would prevent the resurrection of the Sun God.
"Speak."
["Fortunately, the obsessions of the Sun God are not solely about denying his own death. There are also those that strive to maintain it."]
The obsession to maintain death.
Four of Ameris's nine heads, including her, had such obsessions. Among the obsessions left by the Sun God, the largest wills were vested in her.

["It's not just me. Most of those who seek to resurrect the Sun God and those who try to stop it are the same. And in my opinion, your Runecandel family seems to possess some power of the Sun God. Was it a 'blessed body'? The trait that your family has maintained for over a thousand years. It's not something that a mortal can attain on their own. Of course, the potential of mortals is infinite... but it's only within the realm of individual capability. Even the most amazing mortal can't strengthen an entire tribe for a thousand years."]
Ameris was confident that the blessing embedded in the Runecandel was related to the Sun God or an immortal comparable to him.
"Could it not be a blessing from Solderet? Our family did not exist when the Sun God was present."

["The blessings of the Sun God can exist beyond time and space. But even if it's not him, Solderet can bestow such blessings with ease. Anyway, the only immortals capable of maintaining such a blessing for over a thousand years would be the Sun God, myself before I fell asleep, Solderet, and Heluram. But it's unlikely to be the Witch, and I don't think it's me either, so it must be one of the two. Or both."]
"Whichever it is, our family will not stand against you, Ameris."

["Good, the Ziphils who likely received a similar blessing are already my enemies. Even if their goal is not the resurrection of the Sun God but reproducing the artifact called the Origin Stone, they don't seem to be any different in essence. Moreover, they're using the remnants of the Sun God's energy and the Muno, making their sins very heavy."]
"Ameris, in that case, would you like to join our alliance?"
Surprisingly, it was Hedo, not Jin, who made the impromptu recruitment proposal.
["Is there something like a blood oath required for joining?"]
"No, there isn't. It's more
of a gathering formed out of common purpose."
["Then let's go together. It sounds like a fun game."]
Ameris readily accepted the proposal. It was the moment when an incredibly reliable ally was added to the Barmel Alliance.
["But Jin, you said there is someone bringing the demon race from the underground to the surface. Orgal, a demon that doesn't exist in my memory."]
Ameris had been feeling perplexed about this part for a while.
As far as she knew, the guard duty after her slumber had never failed. After all, it was Jin and Hedo who woke her up from the surface world after she fell asleep.

["The entrance to the underground world is only here. And yet, there is a scoundrel who brings the mortals of the underground to the surface without me knowing… He's very vile. I don't know what trick he used, so I'll have to find him, ask him about his method, and punish him. How many demons has that guy called?"]
“I can't tell exactly, but I guess it's no more than ten thousand. However, we believe that there are less than ten demons who pose a real threat.”
["So, he has gathered dust. Has he been sneaking out like a petty thief, avoiding my eyes? Perhaps using the steel dimensional gate ability you mentioned."]
“Probably so.”
["Hmm… if there is an existence capable of dimensional travel to connect the surface and the underground, I wouldn't expect to not know about it. I need to recover my memory quickly."]

“But Ameris, there was a war called the Holy Land Defense War on the surface about 500 years ago. At that time, countless demons came out, and it was the biggest war in human history until the Monster War. The reason we could find this place was thanks to the memory of my ancestor who was active at that time.”

["That could be possible since the Witch got involved in the war at that time. She would have used Zito's immortal object to secretly send the mortals of the underground world up. Even then, she did not directly open the door."]
“I see. Do you remember anything about the immortal Zito? The alliance is currently investigating him too.”

["Zito was an immortal who wished to become a new order. Was he trying to rule the world through pain... He could be classified as a madman one should avoid at any cost. He was a monster that even I, with my nine heads at the time, could not guarantee a victory against. I don't remember how he died."]
As the conversation grew longer, Jin felt a sensation of clearing up a previously clogged pathway in his understanding.
Even though her memory was incomplete, it was certain that the more Ameris's memory returned, the easier it would be to understand the intentions of their enemies.
“Honey!”
At that time, Sandra's voice was suddenly heard. She had been waiting at a distance, curious about the situation, and decided to come over first.
"Oh? Honey, who is this woman? You keep acting like a flirtatious… uh.”
Hedo naturally shut Sandra's mouth, and Jin introduced his comrades who had come from the base to Ameris.
“Valeria Hister, Sandra Ziphil, and Shuri Jokmyo of the Barmel Alliance.”
["Valeria Hister. You're the record wizard Jin mentioned."]
“Yes, Valeria will be of great help in recovering Ameris's memory in the future.”
At the moment when Valeria slightly bowed her head.
Ameris felt the remaining intense power of the Sun God in her. It was a power that no one in the Sun God Church, including Orgal, had been able to recognize.
["Ho... You have a kind of obsession that even I have never seen before, Valeria Hister."]
